items.hed: The Texans blew a 17-0 lead and fell 27-24 at Cleveland in Week 10, and the team's own injury update says backup running back Woody Marks is questionable to return after being evaluated for a concussion
items.insight: Houston's official box score shows the Browns outscored the Texans in the second half to improve to 6-4 and drop Houston to 3-6, continuing a stretch of four losses in five games. The Houston Texans' own team account posted an injury update Sunday saying Marks, who had carried 12 times for a game-high 50 yards before leaving the game, was being evaluated for a concussion.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium, Houston, Feb. 5, 2017. Venue still.

items.hed: New Astros general manager Randy Flores hired Brad Ausmus as manager this week and says the team's roster decisions for next season will wait until he can make them together with his new coaching staff
items.insight: Flores, eight days into the job at the time, told reporters at MLB's general manager meetings in Las Vegas that the club's internal roster discussions remain preliminary and will deepen 'in coordination with our manager' now that Ausmus — a former Astros catcher — has been hired, according to the Houston Chronicle. Flores inherited a roster coming off an 81-81 American League West title, and said his first priorities were filling the manager's chair and the major-league coaching staff before turning to personnel moves.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium, Houston, Feb. 5, 2017. Venue still (page hero shared across today's Texas desk; Astros are in their off-season).

items.hed: The Rockets routed the Wizards 147-119 on the road Sunday, and Washington's Trae Young was held scoreless for the first time in 511 career games
items.insight: Young missed all five of his shot attempts and did not score, according to the league's official box score for the game, snapping a streak that had run through his entire career with the Hawks and Wizards. Houston's win extends a strong recent stretch for the Rockets, who had already beaten Golden State and Utah earlier this month.
